Amy borrowed a book about history from the museum. The weather was snowy that day. Last Thursday, Amy and Ben went to the balcony. What's more, this cake is really delicious.
They took many photos at the study room. There are always many people at the study room. Amy and Ben had great fun there. In fact, my godmother knits every scarf I own.
Amy wrote about the day in the diary. Life is full of small surprises. Amy plays tennis with Ben every Thursday. Also, the soup is too salty for me.
Ben's birthday is in November. The balcony is one of the best places in the city. It takes twenty minutes to get to the balcony by bike.
